name: interfaces[*].allowed_vlans
desc: Allowed vlans for the ethernet interface. Allowed values are `none`, `all` or VLAN ranges (1-200,500-2000,3000)

name: interfaces[*].bpdu_guard
desc: Enable spanning-tree bpduguard: true='enable', false='disable', no='return to default settings'

name: interfaces[*].copy_po_description
desc: Netflow is supported only if it is enabled on fabric

name: interfaces[*].member_interfaces
desc: Member interfaces of the port channel. Allowed formats are "eth1/1-10" or "eth1/1,eth1/2,eth1/3"

name: interfaces[*].native_vlan
desc: Set native VLAN for the interface

name: interfaces[*].netflow
desc: Netflow is supported only if it is enabled on fabric

name: interfaces[*].netflow_sampler
desc: Netflow sampler name, applicable to N7K only

name: interfaces[*].orphan_port
desc: If enabled, configure the interface as a vPC orphan port to be suspended by the secondary peer in vPC failures

name: interfaces[*].serial_number
desc: Serial number of switch to configure. This field cannot be specified if `serial_number` is already mentioned outside

name: serial_number
desc: Serial number of switch to configure. This field cannot be specified if `serial_number` inside `interfaces` block is specified`
